query_name:
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, FORMAT JSON)
select o_year,
  sum(case when nation = 'BRAZIL' then volume else 0 end) / sum(volume) as mkt_share
from (
  select extract(year from o_orderdate) as o_year,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume, n2.n_name as nation
  from part, supplier, lineitem, orders, customer, nation n1, nation n2, region
  where p_partkey = l_partkey and s_suppkey = l_suppkey
    and l_orderkey = o_orderkey and o_custkey = c_custkey
    and c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey and n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey
    and r_name = 'AMERICA' and s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
    and o_orderdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31'
    and p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
) as all_nations
group by o_year
order by o_year
;

extra_info.Dynamic Filters: optional: n_nationkey IN (0, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 22, 23, 24) AND optional: n_nationkey>=0 AND optional: n_nationkey<=24

optional: s_suppkey IN (4, 7, 8, 10, 16, 22, 31, 36, 37, 42, 43, 46, 48, 50, 51, 55, 58, 72, 74, 77, 79, 86) AND optional: s_suppkey>=4 AND optional: s_suppkey<=86 AND optional: s_suppkey IN BF(l_suppkey)

Dynamic Filters: optional: c_custkey>=38 AND optional: c_custkey<=1490 AND optional: c_custkey IN BF(o_custkey)
optional: c_nationkey IN (1, 2, 3, 17, 24) AND optional: c_nationkey>=1 AND optional: c_nationkey<=24

extra_info.Dynamic Filters: optional: o_orderkey>=1 AND optional: o_orderkey<=59489 AND optional: o_orderkey IN BF(l_orderkey)
optional: l_partkey IN (157, 236, 321, 546, 746, 907, 954, 1003, 1037, 1045, 1371, 1830) AND optional: l_partkey>=157 AND optional: l_partkey<=1830
